## ⬇️ Which file do I download?

| Your computer | Download this | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `SnowIsland.exe` | Double-click it. If SmartScreen warns, click **More info → Run anyway**. |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3, M4…) | `SnowIsland-mac-arm64.zip` | Unzip, drag **Snow Island** to Applications, open it. The first time: **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**. |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | `SnowIsland-mac-x86_64.zip` | Same as above. |
| **Linux** (64-bit PC) | `SnowIsland-linux-x86_64` | Right-click → Properties → allow running as a program (or `chmod +x SnowIsland-linux-x86_64`), then run it. |

**Not sure which Mac you have?** Apple menu  → **About This Mac**. *Chip: Apple M…* → arm64. *Processor: Intel* → x86_64.

Mac and Linux versions are new (beta). If something looks wrong, please [report a bug](https://github.com/404existenceerror-dot/snow-island/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). ❄️

Ignore the two "Source code" files at the bottom unless you want the code.
